meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's zero.
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
Stands on what basis? Who decided, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
Students change their argument between an outline and a draft. Which line, and where is it in the essay?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time was not the reason.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, but owning your bad start and turning to specifics made her ask which line, and without the line itself or a document she could check, it could not count as evidence.
What cost ground: Opening with the zero stands and no time for her, when she asked who decided and whether Owen was heard first, confirmed her belief that the school punishes first and asks later.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your October 15 outline was a date in that month but not a late night, so you came near without touching it, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she asked which line, name the exact line and put the page in front of her, so she has something dated she can check for herself.
